
{{alias}}( λ )
    Returns the entropy of a Planck distribution with shape parameter `λ`
    (in nats).

    If `λ <= 0`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    λ: number
        Shape parameter.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Entropy.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 0.1 )
    ~3.3030
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.5 )
    ~0.6833

    See Also
    --------
